name: Smokin Frog Hotbox
description: A finite 99-artwork Smokin Frog collection on Robinhood Chain across five rarity tiers — 3 Legendary 1/1s, 8 Epic, 18 Rare, 30 Uncommon, 40 Common. Rarer artworks have fewer editions and a higher floor. Max supply 1495. Each mint of an artwork raises its price 5%; sold out at the cap.
